pontifex.em.logger[source]
pontifex.em.generate_footprint_randoms_combined(ref_df: pandas.DataFrame, unk_df: pandas.DataFrame, columns=('ra', 'dec'), order_sparse=11)[source]

Generate footprint-corrected random catalogs using SkyKatana. Falls back to bounding box randoms if the catalogs are too small (e.g. in CI) to prevent empty array failures in isolated pixel removal.
